description: A second order parametric EQ with a non-constant Q, so the bandwidth of the peak widens and narrows as the boost and cut is changed.

params.text: Sets the centre frequency of the peak, 20Hz to 20480Hz, starting at 261.63Hz.
Attenuates the cutoff CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.
Sets the quality factor Q, 0.707 to 20, which governs how wide the peak or notch is.
Attenuates the resonance CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.
Sets the gain applied by the filter, -20dB to 20dB, flat at the centre.
Attenuates the boost and cut CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.

inputs.text: The audio to be equalised; sixteen channels are filtered separately.
Shifts the corner frequency by one octave per volt, scaled by its attenuverter.
Raises the quality factor Q; 10V adds the whole range of 20 with its attenuverter at maximum.
Adds to the boost and cut; 10V adds the full 20dB with its attenuverter at maximum.

outputs.text: The equalised audio, clamped between -5V and 5V.

notes: the cutoff, resonance and boost and cut CV inputs are each multiplied by the attenuverter beside them, and those start at zero, so a patched cable changes nothing until one is turned up.
menu: Structure — chooses the arithmetic the biquad is calculated with: Direct, Canonical, TransposeDirect or TransposeCanonical, the last of which stays steadiest under fast modulation.
